messages:
maria: quick design review — batch vectors preview page. spotted a few accessibility + copy nits
ben: thanks. can you list the issues you found?
maria: 1) 'Top matches' header feels ambiguous. users interpret differently. suggestion: 'Top matches (higher = more relevant)' or tooltip
alex: prefer avoid parentheses in header. tooltip + short help text might be cleaner
jia: tooltip is ok. for screen readers we need an aria-label that includes 'score' semantics. right now SR reads 'Top matches, button' which is misleading
maria: 2) long batch inputs are truncated with '...' in preview rows. sighted users can hover to see full text but screen readers don't get the full value
alex: we can add an offscreen element with the full text that becomes aria-describedby when the row is focused
jia: yes — aria-describedby linking to a visually hidden element works. also consider announcing 'expanded' state when a preview is toggled
maria: 3) export CSV column order: current export is [id, vector, score, source]. recommend [id, source, score, vector] — more analysis-friendly for downstream tools
ben: makes sense for data teams
maria: 4) keyboard focus: action menu (⋯) comes after the score cell but tab order jumps to the rightmost control, creating a surprise for keyboard users
alex: likely due to focusable wrapper inside virtualized list. i'll audit tabIndex and the DOM order
jia: ensure logical DOM order matches visual order, add focus-visible outlines, and test with VoiceOver + NVDA
maria: copy nits: primary button says 'Rerank' — might be unclear if it mutates data. suggestion: 'Apply rerank' or 'Run rerank'
ben: 'Apply rerank' reads clearer to me
design-bot: accessibility-check: color contrast for muted text (label metadata) is below 4.5:1 on light theme — current token #9CA3AF, recommend darker shade
maria: noted. i'll update to a heavier gray and push tokens in Figma
alex: i'll prototype the color + keyboard fixes. any concerns about density if text gets darker? might feel heavier but accessibility first
jia: also add aria-live for the results count when rerank completes so screen reader users hear 'Rerank complete — 24 results'
maria: thanks. summary — i'll update the Figma and create an acceptance checklist: 
- header aria-labels + tooltips
- visually hidden full-text for SR + aria-describedby
- CSV column order change
- DOM/tab order fixes + focus-visible styles
- button copy to 'Apply rerank'
- color token tweak for contrast
- aria-live announcement for results count

alex: i'll open a PR and tag @jia for accessibility review. will reference the checklist in the PR body
jia: will review once PR is up, can run the quick axe scan and manual VoiceOver pass
ben: great, thanks all. small ask — can we include a one-line changelog for customer release notes?
maria: draft changelog line: 'Improved embeddings preview accessibility, clarified rerank copy, and fixed CSV export ordering.'
ben: nice. LGTM :thumbsup:
